policies.title: French ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says a valid visa is required before travel and that Burkina Faso entry and stay visas are delivered primarily online through eVisaburkina.
conditions: This is the ordinary French-passport visitor baseline. A visa must be valid before travel; print and retain the electronically issued visa for presentation on arrival.

The separate online fiche voyage is an immigration form, not a visa or ETA. Consular processing, dual Burkinabè nationality, residence, special passports, work, transit, carrier checks and final admission are outside this baseline.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Sierra Leone arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says French nationals remain able to obtain a visa on arrival at Freetown airport while Sierra Leone's online visa system is not yet fully operational.
conditions: The stated ordinary French-passport route is border issuance at Freetown airport. It is not classified as an eVisa merely because the guidance also directs short-stay applicants to an online immigration site before departure.

The source describes an operationally incomplete online system; confirm live carrier and airport arrangements before travel. Residence, work, transit, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Iran preapproved arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance expressly includes France among nationalities that may obtain a short-stay private-travel visa at certain Iranian airports after online preregistration.
conditions: Complete the required online preregistration and present its printed proof on arrival. The visa is issued at specified airports, so the route is preapproved arrival issuance, not an electronically issued visa.

This route is limited to short private travel and requires an ordinary passport; the source expressly excludes diplomatic and service passports. Embassy visa processing, work, residence, transit, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says a visitor with a valid passport may obtain a Jordanian visa on arrival at Queen Alia airport or at any border crossing.
conditions: Use a passport valid for at least six months at arrival. The optional Ministry of Interior online route and online multiple-entry option do not change the separately stated border-issuance baseline.
Jordan Pass, Aqaba, group-tour, diplomatic-passport, transit, residence, extension, carrier checks and final-admission conditions are separate from this ordinary visitor baseline.
